description: 경기도_시외버스 노선 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도버스운송관리시스템(BMS)을 통해 제공되는 시외버스 노선 정보로, 경기도 내 출발 또는 경유하는 장거리 시외버스 노선에 대한 기본 정보를 포함합니다. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 버스운송관리시스템, 공항버스, 버스노선코드, 노선명, 노선관리. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
